tasks.title: Verify and Fix Mobile Responsive Design Implementation
tasks.description:
Review and ensure the calculator is fully responsive on mobile devices:

1. Read existing CSS files to check responsive implementation:
   - src/components/Calculator.css (check media queries and breakpoints)
   - src/components/Button.css (check button sizing for mobile)
   - src/components/Display.css (check display sizing for mobile)
   - src/App.css

2. Verify viewport meta tag in index.html

3. Test responsive behavior:
   - Use playwright-responsive-test.js if available to capture screenshots
   - Check layout at common mobile widths: 375px (iPhone SE), 390px (iPhone 12), 414px (iPhone 11 Pro Max)
   - Check tablet sizes: 768px (iPad)
   - Ensure calculator buttons are appropriately sized and touch-friendly
   - Ensure display text is readable on small screens
   - Verify proper spacing and padding at all breakpoints

4. Fix any responsive issues found:
   - Adjust media query breakpoints if needed
   - Fix button sizing, spacing, or font sizes
   - Ensure the calculator container fits properly on small screens
   - Verify no horizontal scrolling occurs on mobile

5. Update or write tests in src/components/Calculator.test.tsx to verify responsive behavior and ensure they properly test the responsive features

6. Take screenshots at multiple device sizes using playwright to verify the fixes work correctly
acceptance_criteria: Calculator displays correctly on mobile devices (375px-414px width)
Calculator displays correctly on tablets (768px width)
All buttons are touch-friendly and properly sized for mobile interaction
Display text is readable at all screen sizes without horizontal scrolling
Tests written/updated to verify responsive behavior
Screenshots confirm proper layout across device sizes

tasks.title: Validate Mobile Responsive Design
tasks.description:
Validate that the calculator is fully responsive on mobile devices:

1. Run the test suite:
   - Execute: npm test
   - Verify all tests pass, especially responsive tests in src/components/Calculator.test.tsx

2. Visual validation using screenshots:
   - Run playwright-responsive-test.js to capture screenshots at multiple device sizes
   - Verify screenshots show proper layout, sizing, and spacing
   - Check mobile sizes: 375px (iPhone SE), 390px (iPhone 12 Pro), 414px (iPhone 11 Pro Max)
   - Check tablet size: 768px (iPad)
   - Check desktop size: 1920px

3. Verify acceptance criteria:
   - Calculator fits within viewport at all screen sizes
   - Buttons are appropriately sized and touch-friendly on mobile
   - Display text is readable without horizontal scrolling
   - Layout is clean and functional across all tested device sizes
acceptance_criteria: Screenshots confirm proper responsive layout at all tested sizes
Calculator is fully usable on mobile, tablet, and desktop sizes
No visual or functional issues detected
No horizontal scrolling on any device size
